records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, we generated $275.8 million and $811.0 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended September 30, 2025 was: cloud subscriptions 38%; software license 1%; maintenance 11%; services 48%; and hardware 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 was: cloud subscriptions 37%; software license 2%; maintenance 12%; services 47%; and hardware 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $36.4 million and $106.5 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $93.1 million and $242.4 million, respectively.
